answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in island, verified in cedar, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ocean check. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 38 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
